facts.value: Successful completion of a Qualifying Test at CEFR level B 2.2, which takes place at the beginning of each semester unless a Bachelor elective course in Business English has already been successfully completed.

Students with the Cambridge Certificate C1, a score of at least 100 in the TOEFL test, or a score of at least 7.5 in the IELTS test are exempt from the Qualifying Test and must upload proof in PDF format during the given time periods.
A two-stage application process with different deadlines. Both stages must be completed, and the Online Qualifying Test must be passed.

Exam registration and deregistration period: October 8, 2026 – October 21, 2026 via QIS.
